item.tib: che mchog dran pa yang gsang drag po'i rgyud dbang drag rnga rabs ma mo rang 'dus
item.coloph: bdag 'dra o rgyan sangs rgyas gling pas rab brtan phag gi lo'i zla tshes la/ sbas pa'i rong bzhi shar phyogs gnas chen ri yi byang phyogs nyi ma rang shar gnas kyi mkha' 'gro seng gdong phug nas spyan drangs shing slar zla tshes la pho brang chen po drug ldan rnam rgyal rdzong gi dbus rtse ru shog ser bod yig du (tu) bsgyur ba'o//
